author: GoPro
description:
The FWT returns to France for the second edition of the Val Thorens Pro. After a standout debut in 2025 marked by deep snow and an electric home crowd, Val Thorens has quickly established itself as a world-class freeride venue. Set high in the heart of Les Trois Vallées, the stage is set for another unforgettable ski and snowboard showdown as expectations rise for this must-watch stop on the Tour.

After Benjamin James Richards, Justine Dufour-Lapointe, Liam Rivera, and Mia Jones topped the tables at the first stop of 2026, riders will be looking to take it to the next level in the French Alps. Get behind the scenes access from the Baqueira Beret Pro last week with @goprosnow's new series "Off the Record"  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KScozJlzIYI

Want to be featured for your ski & snowboard content? Submit your clips and photos to the GoPro Snow Challenge at GoPro.com/Awards for the opportunity to take home prizes from our $45,000 pool this season.
